SELECT mp.participant_id AS participantId, mp.user_id AS userId, u.nickname AS nickname, mp.input_status AS inputStatus
FROM meeting_participants mp
JOIN users u ON mp.user_id = u.user_id
WHERE mp.meeting_id = #{meetingId} AND mp.user_id = #{userId} AND mp.participant_status = 'ACTIVE'
